description: Use this when the user asks which public holidays (bank holidays) a country or a state/region has in a year, e.g. 'Poland public holidays 2026' or 'Texas state holidays 2027', usually to plan working days. Returns each holiday with date, weekday, English name and whether it falls on a weekend, including the observed weekday off when a holiday falls on a weekend, plus a CSV file. Does not include school holidays, religious observances that are not days off, or company-specific closures. Do not use to check whether a stock exchange is open.

country.description: Country as an ISO two-letter code, e.g. PL, US, GB, DE.

include_bank_holidays.description: Also list bank-only closing days where available, e.g. Dec 24 in Germany. Default false.

subdivision.description: Optional state/region code, e.g. TX (Texas), BY (Bavaria), SCT (Scotland).

weekend_days.description: Weekend days used to flag holidays falling on a weekend, e.g. ["friday","saturday"]. Default from the country.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

name: list_holidays
title: List public holidays
